Transfer PRIO-GRID values between configured resolutions

Source: R/pg_change_resolution.R
pg_change_resolution.Rd

Uses exact cell intersections to allocate extensive totals or area-average intensive values from one configured grid to another. This function does not infer whether a variable is extensive or intensive.

Usage

pg_change_resolution(
  data,
  values,
  from_config,
  to_config,
  variable_type,
  pgid = "pgid",
  time = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  na_rm = FALSE,
  return_crosswalk = FALSE
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing values on from_config.

values

Names of numeric value columns.

from_config

Configuration describing the source grid.

to_config

Configuration describing the target grid.

variable_type

"extensive" or "intensive", either once for all variables or as a named vector.

pgid

Name of the source cell-ID column.

time

Optional temporal key column.

group

Optional additional grouping columns.

na_rm

Should missing source values be ignored?

return_crosswalk

Return only the converted data or a list containing both data and the generated crosswalk?

Value

A data frame on the target grid, or a list when return_crosswalk = TRUE.

Examples

source <- priogrid::pg_config(nrow = 18, ncol = 36)
target <- priogrid::pg_config(nrow = 9, ncol = 18)
x <- data.frame(pgid = c(342, 343, 378, 379), population = rep(10, 4))
pg_change_resolution(
  x, "population", source, target, "extensive"
)
#>   pgid population population_coverage
#> 1   81  10.077138                   1
#> 2   82  10.077138                   1
#> 3   99   9.922862                   1
#> 4  100   9.922862                   1
